steps.label: search-table
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Docs(id INT64 NOT NULL, content STRING(MAX), extra STRING(MAX), tok TOKENLIST AS(TOKENIZE_FULLTEXT(content)) HIDDEN, extra_tok TOKENLIST AS(TOKENIZE_FULLTEXT(extra)) HIDDEN) PRIMARY KEY(id)

steps.label: search-index
steps.sql: CREATE SEARCH INDEX SI ON Docs(tok)

steps.label: snippet-indexed
steps.sql: SELECT id,SNIPPET(content,"test") AS snippet FROM Docs WHERE SEARCH(tok,"test") ORDER BY id

steps.label: alter-search-add
steps.sql: ALTER SEARCH INDEX SI ADD COLUMN extra_tok

steps.label: force-index-_BASE_TABLE
steps.sql: SELECT id FROM Docs@{FORCE_INDEX=_BASE_TABLE} ORDER BY id

steps.label: force-index-PRIMARY_KEY
steps.sql: SELECT id FROM Docs@{FORCE_INDEX=PRIMARY_KEY} ORDER BY id

steps.label: parent-search
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE ParentSearch(pid STRING(MAX) NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(pid)

steps.label: child-search
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE ChildSearch(pid STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,cid STRING(MAX) NOT NULL,title STRING(MAX),tokens TOKENLIST AS(TOKENIZE_SUBSTRING(title)) HIDDEN) PRIMARY KEY(pid,cid), INTERLEAVE IN PARENT ParentSearch

steps.label: interleaved-search-index
steps.sql: CREATE SEARCH INDEX CSI ON ChildSearch(tokens) PARTITION BY pid, INTERLEAVE IN ParentSearch OPTIONS(sort_order_sharding=true)
